import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec4, mix } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const timelines = [];
  const disposables = [];
  const primitiveCleanups = [];

  // Define userData immediately to ensure cleanup hook is registered and verifiable
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      timelines.forEach(tl => {
        if (tl && typeof tl.kill === 'function') tl.kill();
      });
      primitiveCleanups.forEach(cb => {
        if (typeof cb === 'function') cb();
      });
      disposables.forEach(d => {
        if (d && typeof d.dispose === 'function') d.dispose();
      });
    }
  };

  // Color scheme based on visual specification
  const colors = {
    ink: config.colors?.ink ?? '#16161d',
    paper: config.colors?.paper ?? '#e8ecf2',
    accent: config.colors?.accent ?? '#ff2a38',
    surface: config.colors?.surface ?? '#0b0b10'
  };

  // --- STAGE BACKDROP (Vertical Gradient) ---
  const backdropGeom = new PlaneGeometry(7.5, 6.0);
  disposables.push(backdropGeom);

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  disposables.push(backdropMat);

  const inkColor = new Color(colors.ink);
  const surfaceColor = new Color(colors.surface);

  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec4(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b, 1.0),
    vec4(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b, 1.0),
    uv().y
  );
  backdropMat.depthWrite = false;

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeom, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, -1.0, -2.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // --- ACCENT BRAND STRIP ---
  const accentGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.04, 1.2);
  disposables.push(accentGeom);
  
  const accentMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  disposables.push(accentMat);
  const brandRed = new Color(colors.accent);
  accentMat.colorNode = vec4(brandRed.r, brandRed.g, brandRed.b, 1.0);

  const accentStrip = new Mesh(accentGeom, accentMat);
  accentStrip.position.set(-1.8, 0, 0.01);
  group.add(accentStrip);

  // --- BILLBOARDED SPRITE ---
  const spriteWidth = 2.56;
  const spriteHeight = 1.6;
  const spriteGeom = new PlaneGeometry(spriteWidth, spriteHeight);
  disposables.push(spriteGeom);

  const spriteMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(spriteMat);

  const spriteMesh = new Mesh(spriteGeom, spriteMat);
  spriteMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);
  group.add(spriteMesh);

  // Load target sprite imagery
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? '/prism-mock/home/nodes/floating-accent.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    spriteMat.map = tex;
    spriteMat.needsUpdate = true;
    disposables.push(tex);
  }).catch(() => {});

  // Constantly billboard spriteMesh to face camera
  spriteMesh.onBeforeRender = (renderer, scene, camera) => {
    spriteMesh.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  };

  // --- TYPOGRAPHY RENDER ---
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const headlineString = textItems[0]?.text ?? 'Journal';

  const titleText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineString, {
    fontSize: 96,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  titleText.position.set(0.1, -0.05, 0.35);
  group.add(titleText);

  // --- PRIMITIVES APPLICATION ---
  const primitivesConfig = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  for (const prim of primitivesConfig) {
    if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
      const p = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
      if (p) {
        if (p.cleanup) primitiveCleanups.push(p.cleanup);
        if (p.timeline) timelines.push(p.timeline);
      }
    }
  }

  // --- MOTION ENTRANCE ---
  const introTl = gsap.timeline();
  timelines.push(introTl);
  introTl.fromTo(group.position,
    { y: group.position.y - 0.2 },
    { y: group.position.y, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power3.out' }
  );

  return group;
}
